map.它们都用「安全字符集」表示二进制，但字符表不同：Base64 最紧凑常用；Bas: They all represent binary with a safe character set but differ in alphabet: Base64 is the most compact and common; Base32 uses only uppercase letters and digits 2-7, avoiding ambiguous characters for manual transcription; Base58 drops 0/O/l/I and is used for Bitcoin addresses; Base85 is more compact and used in PostScript and PDF.
map.是的。Base32 每个字符只承载 5 bit，比 Base64 的 6 bit: Yes. Each Base32 character carries only 5 bits, less efficient than the 6 bits of Base64, so the size is larger in exchange for readability.
